verses.text: The LORD hates dishonest scales, but he is pleased with honest weights.
When pride comes, shame follows, but wisdom comes with humility.
Honest people are guided by their honesty, but unfaithful people are destroyed by their dishonesty.
Riches are useless on the day of God's anger, but doing what is right saves people from death.
The goodness of blameless people makes their path straight, but the wicked fall because of their own evil.
The goodness of honest people saves them, but unfaithful people are trapped by their own evil desires.
When wicked people die, their hope dies with them. Everything they expected from their power comes to nothing.
Good people are rescued from trouble, and the wicked get into it instead.
Godless people destroy their neighbours with their words, but good people are rescued by their knowledge.
When things go well for good people, the city celebrates. When the wicked die, there are shouts of joy.
A city is made great by the blessing of honest people, but it is destroyed by the words of the wicked.
Whoever looks down on their neighbour has no sense, but a person with understanding keeps quiet.
A gossip tells secrets, but a trustworthy person keeps a secret.
Without wise leadership a nation falls, but with many advisers there is victory.
Whoever guarantees a stranger's debt will surely suffer, but whoever refuses to make such promises is safe.
A kind woman gains respect, but violent men gain only riches.
Kind people do themselves good, but cruel people bring trouble on themselves.
Wicked people earn wages that do not last, but those who plant goodness receive a sure reward.
Whoever is truly good finds life, but whoever chases evil finds death.
The LORD hates people with twisted hearts, but he is pleased with those who live blameless lives.
You can be sure of this: evil people will not go unpunished, but the children of good people will be rescued.
A beautiful woman who has no good sense is like a gold ring in a pig's nose.
What good people want ends only in good, but what the wicked hope for ends in anger.
One person gives freely and gets even richer. Another holds back what he should give, and ends up poor.
A generous person will do well. Whoever refreshes others will be refreshed.
People curse the person who holds back grain to sell at a higher price, but they bless the one who sells it.
Whoever looks for good finds kindness, but whoever looks for evil will find it.
Whoever trusts in riches will fall, but good people will grow like green leaves.
Whoever brings trouble on their family will inherit only wind. A fool will be a servant to the wise.
The fruit of good people is a tree of life, and whoever is wise wins people over.
If good people are paid back on earth for what they do, how much more the wicked and the sinner!
